name: Segmented Control
description: A row of options with a pill that slides to the selected one.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to the container with equal segments.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.description: The selected segment's id, as a one-item array (controlled).

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected id. One segment is always selected.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the track. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components ToggleButtonGroup; give it an aria-label.

props.name: children
props.description: Text, optionally with a lucide icon before it. Give an icon-only segment an aria-label.
